title: Atomistic Modeling and QSPR-Guided Screening of 2D Graphitic Carbon Nitride Nanocarriers for KRAS-G12D Inhibitor Loading and Target Engagement
description: Fully reproducible computational pipeline and data archive for the study of pristine and B/P-doped 2D graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) as a loading scaffold for KRAS-G12D inhibitors. Includes: GFN2-xTB relaxed drug/carrier adsorption energetics (per-complex resume, prior-value fallback), a single seeded AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 docking run against KRAS-G12D (PDB 7RPZ) written directly into the master table, a leak-free nested 5x5 cross-validated RidgeCV surrogate with OECD Principle 3 applicability domain, and an end-to-end master script (run_entire_kras_study.py). Every value in the manuscript is computed from this pipeline; no descriptor or energy is estimated from an empirical formula. v2.0.0 unifies the docking source, seeds all stochastic steps, and adds resume guards to the quantum-chemistry step.
